title: Order move_to before dtype validation for mixed array API inputs in GLMs
answers: Why does PoissonRegressor fail when y and X use different array API namespaces or devices?
TypeError: 'dtype' must be a dtype, not torch.dtype in PoissonRegressor fit or score
How to handle mixed namespace or device array API inputs in GeneralizedLinearRegressor?
When should move_to be called relative to check_array in scikit-learn estimators?
body:
Symptom: Fitting or scoring PoissonRegressor with y or sample_weight from a different array API namespace or device than X fails with TypeError: 'dtype' must be a dtype, not torch.dtype.
Root cause: sklearn/linear_model/_glm/glm.py:_GeneralizedLinearRegressor.fit and sklearn/linear_model/_glm/glm.py:_GeneralizedLinearRegressor.score validated y and sample_weight against X's dtype before transferring them to X's namespace and device via move_to.
Fix pattern: Call move_to(y, sample_weight, xp=xp, device=device) before dtype-coupled validation (check_array and _check_sample_weight) so all inputs share X's namespace and device prior to validation.
Constraints: Applies when estimators support mixed array API inputs across X, y, and sample_weight; move_to is a no-op when inputs already share the same namespace and device.
applies: Generalized linear models in sklearn.linear_model._glm supporting mixed array API inputs.
